name: Dubz.hu
summary: An interactive multiplayer party game where you and your friends compete to create the funniest voiceovers for internet videos. Grab a classic meme or a movie scene, record your best dub, and battle it out against other players. With built-in Twitch integration, your viewers act as the live jury, voting and rating the submissions in real time to crown the ultimate winner! It's a fast-paced, community-driven game built for streamers and their chats.
